# Record exact starting calendar year on Day 1 for cross-era relative pacing (`oe_years_since_start`).
on_game_started_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_fourth_rome_record_start_year
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_start_year } }
